curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A rescue team retrieved the reels left behind by a vanished film crew, but what reality did their cameras capture deep in the rainforest?
curatedMovie.description: After a rescue mission in the Amazon rainforest, a New York University professor returns carrying reels shot by a vanished documentary crew that set out to film local cannibal tribes.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful horror marked by grim dread and steady tension, best suited for focused solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ruggero Deodato constructs a grim, suspenseful horror investigation centered on recovered footage, examining mortal danger and remote peril with unrelenting tension.
